# Codex Account Switcher

> Codex Account Switcher is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar app for ordinary Mac users who need to switch between personal, work, or authorized client Codex accounts. This macOS fork is maintained by hsjx945, based on the original project by Zhao Liu (GitHub: liuzhao1225).

The app is designed for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Users add each authorized account through browser sign-in, then choose and confirm an account from the menu bar. The app handles the Codex Desktop handoff without requiring Terminal commands or config-file editing. It stores account profiles locally, does not proxy Codex traffic, and does not rotate accounts automatically. Codex Account Switcher is independent community software and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

## Guides

- [Switch multiple Codex accounts on Mac](https://hsjx945.github.io/codex-account-switcher/guides/switch-multiple-codex-accounts/): Step-by-step guide for adding, comparing, and switching authorized accounts without Terminal setup.
- [What is a Codex account?](https://hsjx945.github.io/codex-account-switcher/guides/codex-account/): Source-backed explanation of accounts, workspaces, profiles, sessions, Codex Desktop, and CLI behavior.

## Version and data scope / 版本与数据范围

Source version: 0.2.2. Local Token totals cover all readable Codex sessions on this device, for today and the last 30 days; they are not per-account billing. New rollback keys use user-private local files. Release notes identify the signing status of each artifact.

源码版本：0.2.2。本机 Token 是设备级今日及近 30 天统计，不是单账号账单。新回滚密钥使用仅当前用户可读的本地文件；每个 Release 单独说明安装包签名状态。
